# Network_Laplacian_Dynamics

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
The mathematical framework using the graph Laplacian to describe diffusion and toppling processes on complex networks. Provides a rigorous tool for analyzing stability and synchronization in networked computing and neuromorphic systems, essential for TCC/iNEST performance optimization.
